Frequently asked questions

Answers to the questions I am asked most often. One missing? Write to me.

The build

I have no text and no photos. Is that a problem?

No. We write the text together from what you tell me, and I choose royalty-free photos that suit your business. You can replace them with your own whenever you like.

Which website to choose?

The one-page website, if you are starting out or a few lines are enough to introduce you: it is your business card on the internet. The showcase website, if you offer several services or want to rank well on Google: each page covers one topic, and Google can show them all. The online shop, if you want to sell your products online. Not sure? Write to us and we will advise you.

Is the build price really fixed?

Yes. It covers what each type of website includes. A larger website is priced on a quote, and everything is written in the summary before we start.

How is this different from a website made by a developer?

For a showcase website or a small shop, the result is comparable: modern, fast, polished. I work faster thanks to AI, so I cost less. For a custom application or a very large catalogue, a developer's expertise is still irreplaceable, and I will tell you so.

How do I pay for the build?

You pay 25% when you order. When the website is delivered, you pay the rest: in one go, or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments, with your plan.

Ordering

What happens when I order?

You put your website together, then click Order. You read the summary, enter your details and pay online. A confirmation email arrives straight away, with an order reference. I then write to you to get started.

What do I pay today?

Only 25% of the website, plus any one-off options. Your plan only starts when the website is delivered, with the rest paid in one go or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments. The exact amount shows on the button before you confirm.

Can I pay for the website in instalments?

Yes. After the 25% deposit, the rest is paid at delivery, in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments, with the monthly plan. A showcase website at €350: €87.50 when you order, then €43.75 a month for 6 months, or €21.87 for 12 months. Nothing more once it is paid off.

Am I tied in?

No, the plan stops when you decide, at the end of the paid period. The only exception: if you pay the rest of the website in 6 or 12 instalments, you commit for the payment period. You can change your plan and options whenever you like, from your client area. If you leave early, what remains of the website price is due in one go.

Can I change plan?

Yes, up or down, by message: the button is in your client area, Plan and invoices tab. The new price starts from the next period. With a spread payment, the plan continues until the last instalment, whatever its level.

How are invoices issued?

For each payment, Stripe issues the invoice and emails it to you. You can also find it in your client area, Plan and invoices tab. VAT is not shown: the business is VAT-exempt (article 293 B of the French General Tax Code).

What happens if I stop?

You let me know, and the plan ends at the end of the current period. You leave with your domain name and a full copy of your website. Hosting with me stays active for 30 days, giving you time to move.

What if I change my mind?

You have 14 days, by simple email. Since you ask me to start straight away, you only pay for the work already done, pro rata. The domain name already registered stays at your cost: it is in your name, for one year.

The plans

What is the difference between Chico, Power and Titan?

Chico (€5 a month) keeps your website online and up to date on a quality server, with two changes by Lia and one by Alex every month. Power (€15 a month) adds SEO, to push your website up on Google, a faster server, fast support, four changes by Lia and two by Alex. Titan (€30 a month) adds a report on your sales and your figures every month, and ten changes by Lia. Lia makes the small and medium changes, Alex the bigger ones.

What if I need more changes?

For Lia, the Lia + option adds ten changes a month for €5. For Alex, there is the Boost: one extra change for €1, added to your next invoice. You confirm it with each request, from your client area, once the month’s changes are used up.

Lia or Alex: who changes my website?

You choose, with each request. Lia is the AI: it is done in 5 minutes. She prepares the change, shows you a preview, and only changes your website once you agree. Alex is me: I make the change by hand, within 72 hours, and I check it myself. I also check everything Lia does.

Monthly or yearly?

As you like. Monthly, you stop whenever you want. Yearly, you pay for ten months at once and 2 are free. You can switch from one to the other at renewal.

What counts as a change?

A specific change on an existing page: opening hours, a price, a photo, a text, a product. One request, one change. Unused requests do not roll over. A whole page or a new feature needs a small quote.

Are there any hidden costs?

No. The summary shows everything: the creation, the plan and the options you chose. Nothing else.

Your client area

How do I request a change?

From your client area: you write what you want to change, with a photo if needed. You choose who handles it: Lia or Alex. I take care of the rest.

How long does it take?

I reply within 72 working hours, and within 24 hours with Titan. A small change is usually live within that time. I let you know as soon as it is done.

How is my account created?

Automatically, as soon as your order is confirmed. You can also create it beforehand, without ordering anything, on the My account page. Either way, you receive an email with a link to choose your password. If an account already existed with your address, the order is simply linked to it.

Can my account be deleted?

Only if it is no longer used: no login for 12 months and no active plan. I warn you by email 30 days before, and simply logging in cancels it all. As long as your plan is running, your account stays.

Is the client area paid?

No. It is included with your plan: change requests, dashboard, referral and invoices.

SEO

How long until I am on Google?

Your website is submitted to Google as soon as it goes live. People find it quickly by your name. For more competitive searches, allow a few weeks to a few months.

Which plan includes SEO?

The basics are included in every plan: Google can read your website. The monthly work to move it up is included in Power and Titan.

Can you guarantee me first place?

No, and nobody honestly can. I give you every chance and show you every month where you stand.

What is optimised content?

An article or a page that answers a real question from your customers, with clear headings and links to your services. I prepare it with AI and check it before publishing.

I already have a website. Can you improve it?

Yes. I look at your website and tell you what is holding back your visibility. Write to me for a quote.

My method

Will my customers see that the website is made with AI?

No, nothing on your website says so. They see a clean, fast website. For my part, I prefer to tell you how I work: you know what you are buying.

Can AI make mistakes?

Yes. That is why I proofread, test and fix everything before it goes live. AI is fast, but I am the one who approves.

The comparison

Why are you cheaper than an agency?

Because I work differently. AI helps me code faster, and I have no premises to pay for and no team to run. I keep to simple projects that I know how to do well. For a big project, an agency is still the right choice.

How is it different from a do-it-yourself platform?

Who does the work. On a platform, you build the website, update it and write for Google, often in the evening. With me, you describe what you want and I do it. You have no tool to learn.

And compared with a freelancer?

A freelancer builds your website, then every change is negotiated when they are available. My plan takes over from there: hosting, backups, updates and your changes are included every month. You know the price in advance.

If I leave, can I take my website with me?

Yes. The domain name is yours and can be transferred wherever you like. I also give you the website files, so you can host it elsewhere. Nothing ties you down.

Loyalty

How does my referred friend benefit from the referral?

They use your referral link, or enter your code in their order. When their website is online, you each get 1 free month on your plan.

Where can I find my link and my code?

In your client area, under the Referral tab. The link can be shared by message or on social media. The code is typed into the order form. Both give the same benefit.

When is the free month applied?

As soon as your referred friend’s website is online. It is deducted from your next invoice, and from theirs. It cannot be exchanged for money.

Can the benefits be combined?

Yes: you can refer several people. Each referred friend who goes online gives you one more month.

Shall we create your website?

Choose your website and your plan in two minutes. You see the price straight away, and you order when you are ready.
